summary: Viomi Technology Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, reporting unaudited financial results for the first half of 2026. The press release details net revenues of RMB740.0 million, down 49.9% year-over-year, and a net loss of RMB26.3 million, attributed to subsidy phase-out and overseas investments. It discusses operational updates, channel expansion, R&D focus, and shareholder returns, including a special cash dividend of US$0.022 per ordinary share approved in March 2026 and an ongoing share repurchase program. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist activity is disclosed; this is a routine earnings announcement under Form 6-K. What to watch: revenue recovery and overseas expansion progress.
